ui.eyebrow: It starts inside a supported course
ui.lead: SkillBridge adds the language you need to the original AI Academy screen, where navigation, lesson text, and study tools already live.
ui.versionNotice: This page reflects the GitHub v{version} source release. It is not a Chrome Web Store submission; the store still installs legacy v1.0.1. The next CWS version and dashboard upload remain deferred until code development is complete. The listing is currently unavailable in the United States, where GitHub manual installation is the available path.
ui.validationNotice: Automated browser fixtures cover Academy routing and the Tutor transport, but this release does not claim an authenticated post-submit Academy capture or a final signed-in Puter round trip. Both remain final CWS gates.
ui.flowTitle: The lesson stays where it is.
ui.flowLead: Only the language changes. Navigation, protected terminology, your place in the course, and review tools remain in the lesson context.
ui.stepOpenBody: Start in AI Academy as usual. There is no second workspace and no copy-paste translation loop.
ui.stepChoose: Choose a language from the globe menu
ui.stepChooseBody: The readable text on the current lesson changes in place as soon as you choose a language.
ui.stepStay: Stay in the lesson when you need help
ui.stepStayBody: Tutor, flashcards, and bookmarks open beside the course. The paragraph you were reading remains visible.
ui.contextTitle: Translation does not send you to another tab.
ui.contextBody: The course list, lesson body, and review tools stay in one path, so you do not have to stop reading to find your way back.
ui.contextNote: Tutor and review tools open beside the paragraph you are reading.
ui.featureTitle: From first read to review and feedback.
ui.featureLead: SkillBridge keeps more than translation in the course workspace: save, revisit, export, and improve the terms you encounter.
ui.languageLead: Premium dictionaries protect technical terms first. Other supported languages use Google Translate with protected-term restoration.
ui.finalTitle: Open the lesson. Read it in the language that works for you.
ui.finalBody: Turn translation on without an account, then use study tools only when you need them.
ui.footer: Independent community project. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Anthropic or Skilljar.
ui.lessonAlt: AI Academy lesson with SkillBridge translation enabled
ui.contextAlt: A translated AI Academy lesson with SkillBridge controls

featureItems: Translate lesson headings, body copy, navigation, supported comments, and subtitles in place.
Previously translated text remains readable from the browser cache when a connection drops.
Use flashcards, bookmarks, notes, recent lessons, progress, outlines, and PDF export.
Report a passage, review a correction, apply it to an exact match, or roll it back.
Translate supported course subtitles and keep studying in a darker lesson view.
Answer choices stay untouched, and recognized proctored exams disable the extension.
Detect browser language and SPA lesson changes, then open tools from the keyboard.
Premium dictionaries and protected-term restoration keep brand and AI vocabulary intact.
